description: This file contains classes and functions implementing custom data pipeline components for data iteration and shuffling, specifically within the PyTorch data loading framework.

classes.name: SamplerIterDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipe that samples elements from an input data pipe using a specified sampler, with default as SequentialSampler.

classes.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipe that shuffles elements of an input data pipe using a buffer with reservoir sampling methodology.

methods.name: SamplerIterDataPipe.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the sampler data pipe, checking that the input data pipe is Sized, and sets up the sampler.

methods.name: SamplerIterDataPipe.__iter__
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the sampled elements.

methods.name: SamplerIterDataPipe.__len__
methods.description: Returns the length of the sampler if it has a defined size.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the shuffler data pipe with a buffer size and an optional unbatch level.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.set_shuffle
methods.description: Enables or disables shuffling.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.set_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for the random number generator used during shuffling.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__iter__
methods.description: Provides an iterator that yields shuffled data from the input data pipe.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__len__
methods.description: Returns the length of the data pipe if it is Sized.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer and reseeds the RNG for a new shuffle.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__getstate__
methods.description: Returns state for pickling, including RNG state and buffer.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__setstate__
methods.description: Restores object state from a saved pickle, including RNG state.

methods.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe.__del__
methods.description: Clears the buffer when the object is deleted.
